method: Roll calls: final-passage votes read from official Iowa House/Senate Journal PDFs (legis.iowa.gov/docs/publications/HJNL|SJNL/<date>_*.pdf), located via BillBook bill history; yea/nay/absent name lists parsed and verified against the journal tallies. Surname labels resolved to persons via legis.iowa.gov legislator rosters for GA 89 (2021-22), 90 (2023-24), 91 (2025-26); candidates matched to rosters by name. Vote values: Y, N, absent (absent or not voting / excused), "not in office" (not a member of either chamber when the vote occurred; keyed by bill without chamber suffix when not serving in either chamber). LegiScan returned HTTP 403 to curl and was not used. Org lists fetched directly from each org page on 2026-10-28 and matched to todo candidates by name.
